question.text: When did the provisions of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 come into force?

explanation.text: The Logic: The Prevention of Money Laundering Act was enacted in 2002, and its provisions came into force on July 1, 2005. The Trap: Option A (January 1, 2003) is tempting because the Act was passed in 2002, which might suggest it took effect shortly afterwards. The effective date is, however, several years later. Note: There was a gap of roughly three years between the enactment of PMLA in 2002 and the date its provisions came into force on July 1, 2005.
